zh.summary: 把完整性規則抽離畫面，直接用資料測試空白、型別、缺鍵與長度，再讓介面呈現可修正的結果。
objectives: 撰寫不依賴 Streamlit 的 validate 函式。
用正常與負向資料驗證三個必要欄位。
讓錯誤提示保留輸入並支持修正。

readingGuide.goal: 撰寫不依賴 Streamlit 的 validate 函式。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的表單切片、已確認 spec.md 與工作坊 slices/02-validation/。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: rules.py、對應測試與操作紀錄可證明第二切片符合三欄規則。

sections.heading: 畫面限制之外，規則也要站得住
paragraphs: M05 已規定三欄去除首尾空白後須非空，且不超過 80 字元；這些是合成教學規則。畫面 max_chars 限制輸入長度，但其他程式仍可能直接呼叫函式，規則要在函式層保護自己的契約。
slices/02-validation/rules.py 只負責資料判定，不呼叫 Streamlit。這讓測試可以直接傳入 None、數字、超長字串或缺少鍵，而不必先開瀏覽器製造每種輸入。

sections.heading: 像收件臺與檢查清單分工
paragraphs: 收件臺幫人填寫、指出缺漏，檢查清單則定義哪些條件必須符合。換一個櫃臺不該讓清單規則消失；畫面變漂亮也不會使缺件自動變完整。
程式用 validate(record) 接收資料，回傳錯誤訊息列表。空列表表示本次三欄通過，並不涵蓋真實文件內容、身分或正式業務資格。

sections.heading: 先寫可觀察的正反案例
paragraphs: 正常資料可用 SYN-001、DEMO-A、合成申請表。負向案例依每一個必要鍵測空字串、純空白、None、數字、81 字元及缺鍵；另測 80 字元可通過與首尾空白處理。
將案例寫成測試，先觀察未實作時的失敗，再做最小實作。失敗應源自預期的規則差距，語法錯誤或套件未安裝還不能證明驗收測試有抓到需求。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜讓測試跨過畫面限制
rows: 保留原值並顯示當次通過

sections.heading: 從函式結果回到可修正的畫面
paragraphs: 按「檢查資料」才取得本次 validate 的結果。有錯誤時列出缺少什麼及重新檢查方式，原本已填值保留；無錯誤時說明三欄通過，但尚未提供報告與匯出。
第二階段成功訊息只在這次按鈕觸發的重跑出現。下一次輸入變更提交後，畫面重跑並清除先前結果；重新按檢查才產生當次結果。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜規則與畫面的分工
blocks.description: 同一規則函式可由介面及測試呼叫，以下呈現使用者操作循環。

items.title: 呼叫 validate
items.body: 檢查必要、型別、空白與長度。

items.title: 呈現結果
items.body: 有錯則提示並保留輸入；否則說明本次通過。

items.title: 修正後重查
items.body: 變更資料後不沿用舊結果。

sections.heading: 執行第二切片與針對性測試
paragraphs: 先停止先前服務、回解壓根目錄，再進入此階段。各階段分開執行 pytest，避免同名 rules 模組在同一次測試程序互相混用。
直接閱讀 tests/test_rules.py 的每組輸入與斷言，再閱讀 tests/test_app.py 的缺漏、補正及結果消失情境。測試數量不能取代檢查它到底驗證什麼。

blocks.heading: 執行第二切片
paragraphs: 整組測試通過後啟動介面，重演缺漏與補正。
blocks.code:
cd slices/02-validation
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: 規則與驗收都需要留下依據
paragraphs: 常見誤解是「有星號、有字數限制就不需函式驗證」。將規則限制在 UI 會讓直接函式呼叫繞過要求，也難以確認負向情境。
另一個誤解是「通過就能匯出」。本階段還沒實作報告契約與匯出邊界，成功訊息需清楚說明範圍。下一篇才把當次通過資料接到預覽與下載。

exercise.environment: 自己的表單切片、已確認 spec.md 與工作坊 slices/02-validation/。
steps: 先列出正常、空白、缺鍵、型別與長度案例，觀察未實作時的失敗原因。
實作獨立 validate 函式並接回畫面，執行規則與介面測試。
在瀏覽器重演缺漏、補正與變更，記錄保留輸入及沒有下載。
exercise.expected: rules.py、對應測試與操作紀錄可證明第二切片符合三欄規則。
exercise.check: 直接呼叫函式也拒絕負向資料，畫面不把當次通過誤作正式受理。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Separate completeness rules from the interface, test blanks, types, missing keys and lengths directly, then present results that support correction.
objectives: Write validate without depending on Streamlit.
Verify three required fields with normal and negative data.
Preserve input while showing errors that support correction.

readingGuide.goal: Write validate without depending on Streamlit.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your form slice, confirmed spec.md and workshop slices/02-validation/.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: rules.py, matching tests and operation records demonstrating slice two’s three-field rules.

sections.heading: Rules Must Hold Beyond Interface Limits
paragraphs: M05 specifies three nonempty text fields after trimming leading/trailing whitespace, each at most 80 characters. These are synthetic teaching rules. max_chars limits interface entry, but other code may call functions directly; the function must protect its contract.

slices/02-validation/rules.py evaluates data without calling Streamlit. Tests can therefore pass None, numbers, overlong strings or missing keys directly without manufacturing every input in a browser.

sections.heading: Separate the Intake Counter from Its Checklist
paragraphs: The counter helps people enter data and correct omissions; the checklist defines required conditions. Changing counters should not remove rules, and a better-looking screen does not make missing material complete.
validate(record) returns a list of errors. An empty list means this record passed the three-field rules, without establishing document truth, identity or official eligibility.

sections.heading: Define Observable Positive and Negative Cases
paragraphs: Use SYN-001, DEMO-A and a synthetic application-form label for a valid record. For each required key, test an empty string, whitespace only, None, a number, 81 characters and absence of the key. Also test acceptance at 80 characters and trimming.

Write tests, observe the unimplemented behavior failing, then make the smallest implementation. Failure should expose the expected rule gap. A syntax error or missing package does not establish that the acceptance test detects the requirement.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Test Beyond Interface Restrictions
rows: Valid text in all three fields
Fill the missing field and check again
Preserve existing values and show the current pass.

sections.heading: Turn Function Results into Correctable Feedback
paragraphs: Pressing “檢查資料” (check data) obtains the current validate result. Errors identify what is missing and how to recheck while preserving filled values. With no errors, state that the three fields passed, while report preview/export remain absent.

The stage-two success message appears only in the rerun triggered by that check. Committing the next input change reruns the page and removes the prior result; another check generates the current result.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Responsibilities of Rules and Interface
blocks.description: The interface and tests can call the same rule function. This figure shows the user’s correction cycle.

items.title: Read input
items.body: Keep the three current field values.

items.title: Call validate
items.body: Check required values, types, blanks and length.

items.title: Present results
items.body: On errors, explain and retain input; otherwise state this check passed.

items.title: Correct and recheck
items.body: Do not reuse a prior result after changing data.

sections.heading: Run Slice Two and Inspect Focused Tests
paragraphs: Stop the previous service, return to the extracted root, then enter this stage. Run pytest separately per stage to prevent same-named rules modules from being mixed within one test process.

Read each input and assertion in tests/test_rules.py, then the missing-field, correction and disappearing-result scenarios in tests/test_app.py. A test count cannot replace examining what behavior it covers.

blocks.heading: Run Slice Two
paragraphs: After the full test group passes, start the interface and repeat omission and correction.
blocks.code:
cd slices/02-validation
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: Keep Evidence for Both Rules and Acceptance
paragraphs: A required marker or character limit does not replace function validation. UI-only rules can be bypassed by direct function calls and make negative behavior harder to verify.

A passed check does not yet permit export in this stage. Report contracts and export boundaries are unimplemented, so success feedback must state its scope. The next lesson connects currently passed data to preview and download.

exercise.environment: Your form slice, confirmed spec.md and workshop slices/02-validation/.
steps: List normal, blank, missing-key, type and length cases; observe why they fail before implementation.
Implement an independent validate function, connect the interface, and run rule/interface tests.
Repeat omission, correction and input change in a browser; record retained input and the absent download.
exercise.expected: rules.py, matching tests and operation records demonstrating slice two’s three-field rules.
exercise.check: Direct function calls reject negative data too, and the screen does not present a current pass as official acceptance.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

讓非畫面路徑的錯誤資料也受規則約束
rationales: 保護函式邊界且便於測試。

options: To enforce rules on invalid data arriving outside the interface path.
Because the interface is never wrong.
Only to increase the test count.
rationales: This protects the function boundary and supports testing.

zh.prompt: 文件類型是純空白時應得到什麼？
options: 缺少文件類型，保留其他已填值

en.prompt: What should whitespace-only document type produce?
options: A missing-document-type error, preserving other filled values.
rationales: There is no valid report yet.
This supports correction and follows the specification.

zh.prompt: 第二切片成功後修改輸入，應如何處理？
options: 使舊結果消失，重新檢查
rationales: 結果不再代表目前輸入。
符合當次結果的生命週期。

en.prompt: After slice two succeeds, the user changes input. What should happen?
options: Further input cannot affect the result.
Remove the old result and require a fresh check.
rationales: It no longer describes current input.
This follows the lifecycle of a current result.
